steps.title: Start with 8 legs
steps.instruction: Join 8 legs (A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H), as the animation shows. Page 8 of the IKEA manual shows this step.

faq.answer: This guide doesn’t show fittings for the LAIVA bookcase. Page 8 of the paper manual shows which ones to use and how many.

The blue parts: A (leg, about 112 cm), B (leg, about 53 cm), C (leg, about 53 cm), D (leg, about 112 cm), E (leg, about 53 cm), F (leg, about 112 cm), G (leg, about 112 cm), H (leg, about 53 cm). Watch where they go in the animation.
Sizes are approximate: this model has no real measurements, so it is shown about 165 cm tall.
In 8 assembly videos, people took about 45 seconds on this step. Take your time.
